text: Please allow me to give an honest review based on my experience on September 15th, 2025. I was very unimpressed with the service from the young veterinarian. The service was not worth the price, and the welcome was lacking in spirit. It started with a completely indifferent attitude towards the customer. I traveled 11 kilometers from my home to choose this clinic, based on recommendations that it was the best. I messaged them on LINE to schedule an appointment, but upon arrival, the young veterinarian replied three times that my cat's name wasn't in the system, in front of other customers. This was despite this being my third visit. I felt humiliated and had to show them an old receipt to find my cat's name. This indicates a lack of coordination between communication via LINE and in-person service. Even after showing the receipt with my cat's name, the young veterinarian offered no apology, only indifference, as if I didn't exist. I am extremely disappointed with the service, especially since I paid for the service. This is what a professional veterinarian should be doing; they lack professionalism. The clinic's name, "Jamsai Animal Clinic," has become something else entirely. I sincerely hope... This review will be helpful in improving your services in the future. Thank you very much.
